subject: mathematics
question_text: If OA = i + j + k, AB = 3i − 2j + k, BC = i + 2j − 2k and CD = 2i + j + 3k, then find the vector OD.

verification.note: Source: Baby Bullet-Q, Junior Inter Maths-1A (Sri Publishers, Machilipatnam), book p.104 — from the book's separate "STAR QUESTIONS PLUS" bank, answer 157. That bank (book pp.98-111, answers 142-180) sits AFTER all the numbered chapters and is organised by chapter rather than forming part of any chapter's own inventory; it is authored into this unit because that is where the question belongs on the paper (founder decision 2026-08-22). SECTION: classed VSAQ on its length and shape. The bank prints no mark cut, so this classification is OURS — the same chain-of-vectors move as Unit 4's own VSAQ answers. Printed appearances: TS 19. The four given vectors form a CHAIN — the head of each is the tail of the next — so they add straight through to the far end. No coordinates are needed at all. ⚠ THE MARK SPLIT IS OURS, NOT THE BOOK'S — the bank prints no [N Marks] tags anywhere. The shapes used follow the splits the book DOES print elsewhere: 1+1 for a 2-mark VSAQ (answers 100, 101 on book p.82), 1+1+1+1 or 1+2+1 for a 4-mark SAQ (answers 58, 59 on p.63 and 61 on p.64), and the granular split for a 7-mark LAQ (answer 32 on p.44). This is a coaching publication, not a TSBIE document, so the split stays unverified until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — name each move in order.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Chain the four vectors
steps.margin_note: First mark. Apply the triangle law three times: OA + AB = OB, then OB + BC = OC, then OC + CD = OD. The inner letters cancel in pairs.
lines: By the triangle law, adding head to tail:

recall.must_convey: That the triangle law chains the four vectors so OD = OA + AB + BC + CD.
accept: the triangle law chains them so O D is the sum of all four
add them head to tail and the middle points cancel
O A plus A B is O B, plus B C is O C, plus C D is O D
triangle law tho nalugu kalipithe O D vasthundi
chain the four vectors to reach D

steps.why: Only the first tail (O) and the last head (D) survive the chain. Every intermediate point appears once as a head and once as a tail, so it cancels.
common_mistakes: Trying to find position vectors of A, B, C separately.

steps.label: Add the components
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Add the i parts, the j parts and the k parts separately.

recall.must_convey: That the components add to give OD = 7i + 2j + 3k.
accept: adding the components gives seven i plus two j plus three k
the i parts give seven, the j parts two and the k parts three
O D is seven i two j three k
components kalipithe seven i two j three k
the answer is seven i plus two j plus three k

steps.why: Adding component by component keeps the three totals apart, so one sign slip stays inside one component instead of spreading.
common_mistakes: Mixing the j and k columns.
Dropping the minus signs on the second and third vectors.
